osm_file.description: Path to the input OSM file (required).

db_user.description: Username with write access to the database.

conf_file.description: Path to the configuration XML file.

db_schema.description: Database schema to put tables. Leave empty for default search_path.

db_prefix.description: Prefix added to the beginning of table names.

db_suffix.description: Suffix added to the end of table names.

clean.description: Drop previously created tables before import.
